root_cause_analysis.symptom: BA subagent corrupted cp-state via direct Edit; cp-state survived Stop with agent_id cleared; downstream dev subagent inheriting a colliding agent_id was misclassified as ba and denied writes.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Three independent hook-chain holes: (1) tool-policy allows per-role direct write to own cp-state; (2) Stop hook finalizes only by exact agent_id match; (3) resolver falls back to first inactive cp-state match instead of returning None.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — these holes have been present since the cp-state lifecycle was introduced; no single regression commit. Forensic file timestamp 2026-05-07T14:27:54Z (spec-20260506-203755/cp-state-ba.json).
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Per-role cp-state allow was added to give each agent self-mark capability before spec-check.py existed as the canonical writer (commit history pre-spec-check.py). Stop hook agent_id-only matching was an isolation choice to avoid cross-agent finalization. Resolver inactive fallthrough was a legacy single-match convenience for early single-spec usage.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: All three holes compose to let a single misbehaving BA poison the next subagent's role classification. The forensic at spec-20260506-203755/cp-state-ba.json shows evidence-fields injected by direct Edit (only path that produces them) plus agent_id cleared (only path that produces this is check-out OR direct Edit clobber).
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Bug 1 mechanism: present since per-role cp-state writes were added to tool-policy. Bug 2 mechanism: present since Stop hook's agent_id-keyed dispatch. Bug 3 mechanism: present since agent_resolver._scan_cp_state_files added the legacy single-match fallback. All three were latent until cycle 20260506-203755 exercised them simultaneously.

development_approach.strategy: Three independent fixes, each implementable separately. Suggested ordering: (1) AC-3 (smallest, agent_resolver fallthrough -> None); (2) AC-2 (subagentstop _finalize_orphans); (3) AC-1 (tool-policy edits + new guard hook + settings.json wiring — most steps and most risk because the guard hook must allow orchestrator while denying subagents). Each fix MUST be validated by python3 -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open(...).read())' before the next subagent dispatch. Acceptance tests in /tmp/test-cpstate/, /tmp/test-orphan/, /tmp/test-resolver/ as described in each AC.
development_approach.validation_approach: QA verifies each AC's verifiable test (synthetic cp-state in /tmp/) passes; QA also verifies the BA self-test scenario succeeded (this BA cycle used spec-check.py mark for its own check-in, demonstrating the contract). QA must also confirm: existing /spec /dev /redev /close BA workflows still succeed (check by running spec-check.py mark in a synthetic spec dir post-fix).

research_findings.reason: Hook-chain semantics are project-specific; codex adversarial review of the AC drafts (with line-cited references to actual source) is the appropriate validation, not industry web search.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: AC-1 needed the glob widened to numbered slots ('*/.claude/specs/*/cp-state-*.json' not just 'cp-state-AGENT.json'), the dev '*' blanket-allow tightening, the spec role's .claude/specs/ allow tightening, and a path-specific role-independent backstop hook to cover the unresolved-role exit-0 caveat at pretool-tool-policy.py:99-101. AC-2 was rejected as initially framed (the active-state path already handles is_running=true + terminal cps via _handle_complete); the real failure mode is agent_id clobber producing orphan slots invisible to _find_all_slots_for_agent's exact-equality filter; AC-2 was reframed as orphan finalization. AC-3 was confirmed but tightened: inactive cp-state matches must be entirely non-authoritative (return None at line 94 instead of matches[0].get('agent_type')), so dev-registry agent-index naturally takes precedence in the inactive-shadow case.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: AC-1 glob updated to cp-state-*.json with explicit coverage of numbered slots. AC-1 implementation requirements expanded to include dev '*' blanket tightening AND a new pretool-cp-state-write-guard.py hook independent of role resolution. AC-2 fully rewritten: now targets orphan slots (is_running=true + null agent_id OR dead pid) via a new _finalize_orphans() function, preserving M11 pending-block invariant. AC-3 tightened: _scan_cp_state_files inactive fallthrough returns None instead of matches[0].
